data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 26/1456Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO REMAINS A POWERFUL HURRICANE. ...EXPECTED TO MAKE LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR ON MONDAY AS A STRONG HURRICANE... As of 8:00 AM MST Sat Sep 26 the center of Polo was located near 17.9, -111.7 with movement WNW at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 928 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 155 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 26/1442Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS EXPECTED TO RAPIDLY WEAKEN OVER THE OPEN EAST PACIFIC. As of 8:00 AM PDT Sat Sep 26 the center of Odalys was located near 19.8, -123.7 with movement N at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 965 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 105 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Gonzalo (AT2), advisory 26/1440Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: GONZALO MOVING NORTH OF THE CABO VERDE ISLANDS AND EXPECTED TO DEGENERATE INTO A REMNANT LOW BY SUNDAY. As of 2:00 PM CVT Sat Sep 26 the center of Gonzalo was located near 18.8, -23.0 with movement NNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 26/1437Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY DRIFTS TOWARDS THE WEST-SOUTHWEST. As of 3:00 PM GMT Sat Sep 26 the center of Fay was located near 29.6, -44.0 with movement WSW at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1009 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
